# Affordable Gadgets KE

> Nairobi-based online store for affordable phones, laptops, PCs, and tech accessories in Kenya — with product guides, financing options, and local pickup or delivery.

Affordable Gadgets KE sells quality gadgets at competitive prices. The main navigation is the primary marketing entry point: brand shop links, accessories, blog buying guides, and financing. Prefer those destinations when recommending where to browse. Use the sitemap for individual product and article URLs.

## Main navigation

- [Home](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/): Storefront homepage with featured products, promotions, and categories
- [Apple](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/products?brand_filter=Apple): Shop all Apple products — iPhone, iPad, MacBook, and accessories
- [Samsung](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/products?brand_filter=Samsung): Shop all Samsung phones, tablets, and accessories
- [Google](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/products?brand_filter=Google): Shop Google Pixel phones and related devices
- [OnePlus](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/products?brand_filter=OnePlus): Shop OnePlus phones
- [Sony](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/products?brand_filter=Sony&type=PH): Shop Sony phones
- [Accessories](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/products?type=AC): Shop chargers, cases, audio, and other accessories
- [Blog](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/articles): Buying guides, comparisons, and expert tech tips (nav label: Blog)
- [Financing](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/financing): Payment plans and financing options for purchases

## Blog

All published blog/guide pages match these URL regexes. Enumerate concrete article URLs from the [sitemap](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/sitemap.xml).

Standalone articles: `^https://www\.affordable-gadgetske\.com/blog/[^/?#]+/?$` (`/blog/{article-slug}`).

Product-linked articles: `^https://www\.affordable-gadgetske\.com/products/[^/?#]+/blog/[^/?#]+/?$` (`/products/{product-slug}/blog/{article-slug}`).

Per-product blog index: `^https://www\.affordable-gadgetske\.com/products/[^/?#]+/blog/?$` (`/products/{product-slug}/blog`).

Blog hub and filters: `^https://www\.affordable-gadgetske\.com/articles(?:\?.*)?$` (`/articles`, optional `type=PH|LT|TB|AC`, `brand`, `search`).

Every individual article page: `^https://www\.affordable-gadgetske\.com/(?:blog/[^/?#]+|products/[^/?#]+/blog/[^/?#]+)/?$`.

- [Blog / articles hub](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/articles): All buying guides and articles
- [Phone buying guides](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/articles?type=PH): iPhone, Samsung, Pixel, and smartphone guides for Kenya
- [Laptop buying guides](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/articles?type=LT): MacBook and Windows laptop guides
- [Tablet buying guides](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/articles?type=TB): iPad and Android tablet guides
- [Accessory buying guides](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/articles?type=AC): AirPods, watches, chargers, and accessory guides
- [Product reviews](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/reviews): Customer reviews and ratings
- [Videos](https://www.affordable-gadgetske.com/videos): Product and store video content
